app.name: Kalam
app.tagline: Draw the app you need. Own it forever.

errors.updateReady: A new version of Kalam is ready.

notFound.title: This page isn't on your shelf
notFound.description: The link may be old, or the app it pointed to was deleted from this device.

shelf.title: Your shelf
shelf.loadError: Could not read your apps from this device.

search.label: Search your apps
search.hint: Search looks at app names and descriptions.

toast.pinned: Pinned to the top of your shelf
toast.duplicated: Made a copy of {name}. Records were not copied.

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.message: This removes the app, its saved versions and every record stored in it on this device. Backups you exported stay wherever you saved them.

create.title: New app
create.intro: Use one way or mix several. Everything you add goes into the same app.
create.stopped: Building stopped. Everything you added is still here.
create.ready: Your app is ready to review.
create.addDetails: Add these details to your description:
create.empty: Nothing added yet. You can combine several inputs.

heading.photo: Show Kalam a sketch or a page

text.placeholder: Describe the app you want to create
text.exampleHint: Replaces the description with this example

photo.limit: Four photos is the limit. Remove one to add another.
photo.error: That image could not be opened. Try a JPEG or PNG.

voice.unavailable: Speech recognition is not available here. Type your idea in Describe instead.
voice.transcriptPlaceholder: Your words appear here. Fix anything Kalam misheard.

video.error: This video could not be read. Try an MP4 under 60 seconds.

draw.empty: Draw something or place a component first.
draw.screensHint: Each page becomes one screen of your app.

prefs.title: App preferences
prefs.hint: Optional. Kalam picks sensible defaults when these are left empty.

error.cloudTitle: This app needs the cloud to build
error.cloudBody: You are offline, and this idea is too detailed to build on this device. Your input is kept. Try again when you are connected.
error.failedTitle: Kalam could not build this app yet
error.generic: Something went wrong while building. Your input is kept.

review.title: Review before saving
review.tryHint: Try it out here. Nothing you enter in the preview is saved.
review.noSummary: Kalam built this app but has no summary for it. Use the preview to check it.
review.changePlaceholder: e.g. add a phone number field and show the total pending at the top
review.saveError: The app could not be saved. Your preview is still here. Try again.
review.discardMessage: The generated app is thrown away. Everything you described, photographed or drew stays in your session.

empty.title: Nothing to review yet
empty.description: Describe, sketch or draw an app first. Kalam shows what it understood here before anything is saved.

section.noAi: None. Everything in this app runs without AI.

missing.title: This app isn't on this device
missing.description: It may have been deleted, or the link came from another device.

edit.placeholder: Add a phone number field, or make the buttons blue
edit.proposedHint: The preview shows it. Nothing is saved until you keep it.
edit.saveFailed: Couldn't save the change. Your app is unchanged.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Saved on this device. Changes apply straight away.
settings.saveError: Could not save that setting. It was changed back.

access.title: Access modes
access.description: Applied to Kalam and every app you make. Turn on any mix, and turn them off at any time.
access.largeHint: Bigger text and touch targets in Kalam and your apps.
access.highContrastHint: Stronger text, borders and focus outlines. Overrides app colours.
access.simpleHint: Fewer options on screen. Hides the Activity page.
access.readAloudHint: Your apps speak headings and results.
access.leftHandedHint: Main actions move to the left in your apps. Text direction never changes.

language.title: Language
language.description: Kalam's screens use this language. Existing apps keep their own language.
language.draft: This translation is a draft. Some wording may read wrong.

storage.title: Storage and backup
storage.description: Your apps and their records are stored only on this device. Keep a backup file somewhere safe.
storage.deleteMessage: Every app, version, record, drawing and the activity log will be permanently removed from this device. This cannot be undone.
storage.deleted: All apps and data were deleted from this device
storage.deleteFailed: Could not delete everything. Some data may remain.

ai.title: AI and privacy
ai.mode: When Kalam builds or edits an app

activity.title: Activity
activity.loadError: Activity could not be read from this device.
activity.clearMessage: This deletes the activity log on this device. Your apps, their data and the on-device AI counter are not affected.

empty.title: No AI activity yet
empty.description: Create an app to see its steps here. Each one shows if it used a template, Gemini Nano on this device, or Gemini in the cloud, and how long it took.

onboarding.languageHint: Used for new apps, voice and read-aloud. Change it any time in Settings.
onboarding.local: Everything you make is saved on this device.
onboarding.saveError: Could not save your choice. Try again.
